subject.title: fix #95351: [Feature]: Generic JSONL line-parsing hook for CliBackendPlugin (native tool-card support beyond claude-stream-json)

question: Should OpenClaw make `parseJsonlEvent` and its normalized event union a supported public `CliBackendPlugin` contract for provider-specific JSONL streams?
rationale: The implementation follows the documented provider-owned hook boundary, but exporting a parser and event vocabulary commits the plugin SDK to semantics external plugins may adopt; tests and contributor proof cannot choose that long-term API direction.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK hook
options.body: Accept the callback as the canonical provider-owned JSONL extension seam, then require a rebase and refreshed focused proof before merge.

options.title: Keep JSONL parsing internal
options.body: Decline the new public contract and close or redirect the feature request unless maintainers identify a different supported extension seam.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK hook
recommendation.body: Accept the callback as the canonical provider-owned JSONL extension seam, then require a rebase and refreshed focused proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review context explicitly routed the public plugin SDK decision to this repository figure, though direct ownership evidence remains limited.
